description: Verify that resetInterface Fire&Forget with wrong interface_version — DUT must stay silent
approach:
[Objective]
Fire&Forget never produces a Response — even with wrong interface_version, DUT must not emit Error (RPC_05 family).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester → DUT: Method Request (per-case shape).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: Method Response (or absence) per the asserted behaviour.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted response satisfies the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Fail_phase2_dut_responded_to_fire_forget: DUT emitted response to wrong interface_version Fire&Forget
